in_sanskrit.name: शिद्दू
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is unwavering, steadfast, and firm in their beliefs.

in_marathi.name: Siddu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Siddu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lord Shiva, the destroyer in Hindu mythology, is the source of this name. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shidh', which means 'to destroy'.
